note: Marszałkowska along Plac Defilad and Muzeum Sztuki Nowoczesnej, from just south of the Świętokrzyska junction past the Złota crossing, as rebuilt in 2025-26 (Zielona Marszałkowska: ZDM June 2025, trams back 13 Oct 2025, Złota crossing Nov 2025, Sienkiewicza-Fangora crossing 3 Aug 2026). Axis: the tram midline (palace.json m_south from s 170, just past Fangora's exit, to s 328). Offsets in metres to the right of the axis (the axis runs south; right = west, the museum side).
